author: Vox
description:
Most of the focus in this year’s midterms is naturally on Congress. But the battle for control of  state legislatures matters just as much, if not more.

Currently, Republicans hold a trifecta — control of the governorship, state senate, and state house — in 23 states, while Democrats hold 16.

Flipping just a handful of state seats can change who holds the majority of power nationwide. That has major policy implications. On this week’s episode of America, Actually, Vox’s Astead Herndon travels to Wisconsin to dig into the national strategy behind state-level trifectas, what’s at stake for working-class voters, and what it takes to flip rural districts.

author: Vox
description:
In Wisconsin, Gov. Tony Evers’ late endorsement of David Crowley shook up the state’s Democratic primary for governor. Former Wisconsin gubernatorial candidate Francesca Hong talks to Vox’s Astead Herndon about how news of that endorsement impacted her and her campaign.
